title: Reduce idle non-production compute spend

evidence.statement: Non-production compute represented 21% of July compute spend.
38 instances had median CPU below 5% and no weekend traffic.

recommendation: Pilot scheduled shutdown for tagged development instances outside working hours.

risks.mitigation: Exclude CI runners and provide opt-out tag with expiry.

verification: Compare normalized compute cost for four weeks after rollout against baseline and usage-adjusted forecast.
